mode: image2image (vanilla CSFF card art as style reference)
prompt:
Use the attached reference images, each for one purpose.
Reference image 1 is the CHARACTER: draw this exact same man, the village potter (narrow angular face, high cheekbones, long straight nose, short curly dark-brown hair greying at the temples, short trimmed brown beard, tanned skin, rust shirt with rolled sleeves, clay-stained oatmeal canvas apron, brown leather belt), keeping his face, age, hair and beard identical, and keeping his upright standing posture with a small clay cup held up in one hand.
Reference image 2 is a style reference only (a scene from the game Card Survival: Fantasy Forest): match its muted, low-saturation palette and flat rendering exactly; do not copy its subject.
Action: market day in a village square under a grey overcast sky. He STANDS in front of his pottery cart, on the near side of it, his whole upper body and legs to the knee clear of it, holding up a plain terracotta clay cup to show it. Directly behind him is his two-wheeled wooden hand cart with plank sides, its bed loaded with plain terracotta clay bowls, cups and two tall jugs, a faded tan canvas cloth draped over one corner. Behind the cart, simple timber cottages and a dirt square.
Framing: three-quarter view of him from the knees up, standing, centred, the cart filling the middle ground behind him, only this one person.
Colour: toned down and muted: faded brick-red instead of bright orange for his shirt, dull oatmeal apron, dusty terracotta pots, grey-brown wood, grey sky. Low saturation throughout.
Style: flat posterized colour fills in a few tonal steps, cel-like, no soft gradients, no watercolour bleed, no paper texture; thin dark ink outlines and small ink hatch marks; realistic proportions and a realistic, unidealised face; nothing glossy. The painted scene reaches every edge of the frame. No text, no watermark, no signature, no border, no frame.
Avoid: footprints, tracks, prints in the ground, mud or snow, sitting, standing behind a counter, a counter between him and the viewer, red-and-white striped awning, hams, sausages, hanging meat, pelts, furs, animals, a crowd, other people, bright saturated colours, vivid orange, golden glow, storybook illustration, glossy skin, airbrushed shading, photo, 3D render, anime, cropped face, a different face, a clean-shaven man, a young man, glasses, pottery wheel, kiln, plain white background, vignette, white border.
note: Owner-approved 2026-10-10 in the Card Art Redo Review (second round, redrawn from the owner's notes on the first). Finished by /process-card-art --full-bleed.
